title: Beat 137 - Descent
description: A figure in an orange hazmat suit and helmet stands on an upper metal walkway holding a glowing electronic device, looking down into a large industrial chamber. Below, a massive ornate door emits purple light while chained mummies and numerous shadowy human silhouettes populate the foggy green and purple lower level, surrounded by warning tape and framed pictures on decaying walls.
prompt: A man in an orange hazmat suit and full helmet stands on a rusted metal catwalk inside a decaying industrial facility, holding a futuristic scanning device that glows with cyan light. He looks down into a deep purple chamber where a massive ornate vault door stands open, emitting eerie purple glow. A mummified body wrapped in yellow warning tape hangs from chains on the left. Below, numerous dark silhouetted human figures wander through green glowing mist. The walls are covered with old framed pictures and graffiti. Cinematic lighting, atmospheric perspective, detailed textures.
